title: 散文 15
content:
I'll be waiting
Baby please forgive me for what I have done, for I know I have broken your heart and I know that I will never be able to get you back in my arms again, All I want is you back in my life, or is that to much to ask? to keep me safe from harm and for you to make me believe in again, You made me so happy and actually made me want to live to see the next day, Now that your gone in lost without you and I want to tell you things that I will never say in my life I and I want to hold you when the sun refuses to show, I want to show you that I will always be by your side when you call my name and you need me there I will be waiting for you when you close your eyes and you see me there I will be waiting, I want to kiss you like ill never kiss you again "if its ok", I can’t image loving any other this way, baby you know that ill be waiting, so what you want to do I want to wish you, I know your like my star ,so why don’t you stay a while and when you want me to ill wait for you.
